Roof Replacement Cost Atlanta

Looking to replace your roof? Build Heritage gives you a clear, itemized quote for roof replacement in Atlanta and the surrounding Georgia area. We cover all eight trades, from framing to roofing, and respond within one business day.

How a Roof Replacement Quote Works for You

  1. Fill the Quote Form – Provide your address, roof size, and any special requests.
  2. We Review – Our team checks the details and prepares an itemized estimate.
  3. Receive Your Quote – You get a written, itemized quote that includes our cost range and a 10‑15% recommendation for hidden issues.
  4. Make Your Decision – Review the quote and decide if you want to move forward.

All this happens in one business day, so you’re not left waiting.

What You Get & How Much It Costs

  • Itemized Quote – Every line item is listed so you know exactly what you’re paying for.
  • Cost Range – A full roof replacement in Atlanta typically costs $9,000‑$20,000.
  • Hidden‑Issue Buffer – We advise holding back 10‑15% of the quoted amount for unexpected problems.
  • Licensed & Insured – We are licensed and insured in Georgia.

FAQ

What areas do you serve for roof replacement? We serve Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

Do you handle interior work after the roof is replaced? Yes, we offer painting, drywall, flooring, and other interior trades if you need them.

How long will the roof replacement take? We provide a schedule after the quote, but all estimates are ready within one business day.

Get a free roof replacement quote now
